title: Initial query structure for majority trees
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on three coordinates with sign-valued inputs and outputs that computes majority, with ties assigned the positive sign. Its root must query some coordinate $i$. For each sign $a$, the corresponding child must query some coordinate $j\ne i$; for each sign $b\ne a$, the resulting child must query some coordinate $k$ distinct from both $i$ and $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a decision tree on three coordinates with sign inputs and outputs
$T$ computes three-coordinate majority, with nonnegative sum mapped to positive sign
